apis.name: USDA FoodData Central
apis.why_notable: Official US nutrition database with branded, foundation, and survey foods; free API key.

apis.name: Open Food Facts
apis.why_notable: Crowdsourced global product nutrition and ingredients database with barcode lookup.

apis.name: Nutritionix
apis.why_notable: Natural-language food logging and restaurant nutrition; popular free developer tier.

apis.name: Edamam Nutrition Analysis
apis.why_notable: Ingredient and recipe nutrition analysis with free developer quota.

apis.name: Edamam Food Database
apis.why_notable: Autocomplete and nutrient lookup for grocery foods; free developer plan.

apis.name: Spoonacular
apis.why_notable: Recipes, meal planning, and nutrition endpoints widely used in food apps.

apis.name: FatSecret Platform API
apis.why_notable: Large food database and barcode nutrition for calorie-tracking apps.

apis.name: OpenFDA
apis.why_notable: FDA drug labels, adverse events, recalls, and device data; free, no key for basic use.

apis.name: NIH ClinicalTrials.gov API
apis.why_notable: Official registry of clinical studies worldwide; modern JSON v2 API.

apis.name: PubMed E-utilities
apis.why_notable: Programmatic search of PubMed biomedical literature via NCBI E-utilities.

apis.name: UMLS Terminology Services
apis.why_notable: NIH UMLS REST API for medical concepts, CUIs, and crosswalks.

apis.name: RxTerms
apis.why_notable: NLM Clinical Tables API for prescription drug name autocomplete.

apis.name: ICD API (WHO)
apis.why_notable: Official WHO ICD-11 API for diagnosis coding and classification.

apis.name: HPO API
apis.why_notable: Human Phenotype Ontology search and annotation for rare disease phenotypes.

apis.name: MyFitnessPal API
apis.why_notable: Legacy food diary platform; verify current partner/self-serve status carefully.
